findings.premise: The design's bounded diff-review contract covers every production review route without an alternate bypass.
findings.evidence: For daemon-authored code, beginDiffOnlyReview still calls emitJudgementsResult with the complete grounding. That function constructs every dimension's whole-grounding prompt and returns `next:'emit_judgements', prompts, grounding, state`; it performs no chunk planning or input measurement. handleJudgements subsequently injects judges that simply return supplied results, bypassing runDimensionJob/runReviewJob. The LLD specifies bounded execution through those daemon seams and changes this handler for pending daemon operations, but does not design a bounded controller review protocol. Splitting rows alone leaves the same oversized aggregate prompts and omits required fragment-parent validation/gather on this independent-review route. findings.action: Design the controller diff branch explicitly: bounded identified calls, fitted material, parent-note validation/gather, deadline handling and continuation. findings.premise: The proposed daemon failure handling identifies the existing unsafe refusal, cancellation and wait-lifetime seams.
